milestone: Genuine XNU Kernel Initialization, Thread Scheduling & Darwin Kernel Services

tests.description: Verifies boundary execution advancement beyond Campaign 209 WFI checkpoint, confirming kmem_init, zone_bootstrap, sched_init, task_init, thread_init, and mailbox 0xCAFEBABE210.
Verifies physical page metadata structures in guest memory, validating 496 available pages starting at 0x40000, attributes table, and metadata header.
Tests PhysicalPageManager integration with guest memory, page allocation/deallocation, exhaustion limits, and double-free rejection.
Validates bounded kernel heap allocator, boundary protections, multi-block allocation, alignment, and state serialization.
Validates VirtualPageTable mapping, dynamic L3 table allocation, translation walk, and in-memory guest kernel_map header.
Tests XnuVmMap core operations: vm_map_enter, vm_map_lookup, vm_map_protect, vm_map_wire, vm_map_find_space, and vm_map_remove.
Tests XnuZoneAllocator fixed-size zone creation, element allocation/free, bitmap management, exhaustion, and serialization.
Validates KernelTaskManager and KernelTask lifecycle, PID 0 kernel_task creation, task suspension/resumption, and memory limit accounting.
Validates ARM64 thread context register layout, GuestTcb serialization, GPR/SP/PC preservation, and architectural register restoration.
Tests KernelThread lifecycle states (Ready, Running, Blocked, Terminated), quantum accounting, thread priority, and state transitions.
Validates PriorityScheduler 32-tier priority run queues, highest-priority thread selection, round-robin at same priority, and yield operations.
Validates authentic 22-instruction ARM64 guest context switch routine emission, register preservation, and CPU execution.
Tests timer-driven preemption, quantum expiration after 10 ticks, dispatching, and 15-instruction guest IRQ handler emission.
Validates exception vector table setup, AIC2 interrupt delivery, ESR_EL1/FAR_EL1 syndrome decoding, and VBAR_EL1 registration.
Validates SMP kernel initialization for 2 and 6 cores, per-core CPU structures, boot synchronization mailboxes, and core affinity.
Tests KernelSpinlock acquire/release, deadlock detection, IRQ-safe spinlock guard (DAIF masking), and WaitQueue FIFO/priority wake ordering.
Tests MachPort and MachMessageQueue IPC foundations, port rights (Receive, Send, SendOnce), bounded message queuing, and blocking semantics.
Validates snapshot serialization and bit-exact state restoration across VM maps, zone allocators, tasks, threads, and schedulers.
Adversarial security validation across 16 hostile attack vectors including privilege escalation, null pointer dereference, UAF, and buffer overflow.
Validates EL0 user thread context, SPSR_EL1 target mode EL0t, minimal EL0 instruction execution, and UserExecute/KernelExecute boundary protection.
